sources.quote: puts about one in four Canadians in an unpaid caregiving role
sources.title: The Daily — Caregivers in Canada, 2018
sources.evidence: In 2018, approximately one in four Canadians aged 15 and older (or 7.8 million people) provided care to a family member or friend with a long-term health condition, a physical or mental disability, or problems related to aging.

sources.quote: Better at Home, funded by the province and managed by United Way BC, delivers non-medical help such as housekeeping, grocery shopping and transportation through local non-profits
sources.title: Better at Home - Province of British Columbia
sources.evidence: Better at Home is a province-wide program funded by the Government of BC and managed by the United Way of the Lower Mainland. Seniors have access to a range of non-medical home support services such as housekeeping, grocery shopping, home repair, friendly visiting, snow shovelling, yard work and transportation to appointments. Services are delivered through local non-profit organizations by volunteers and paid workers.

sources.quote: Veterans Independence Program provides annual funding to eligible veterans, survivors and primary caregivers for services including housekeeping, meal preparation and personal care
sources.title: Veterans Independence Program | Veterans Affairs Canada
sources.evidence: The Veterans Independence Program provides annual tax-free funding for services such as grounds maintenance, housekeeping, meal preparation, personal care, and professional health and support services. The program is available to Veterans and also extends to primary caregivers and survivors.

sources.quote: Only members of a provincial nursing college may be presented as a nurse, RN or RPN, under statutes such as Ontario's Nursing Act, 1991
sources.title: Fact Sheet: The Nursing Act, 1991
sources.evidence: Titles used by nurses are protected under the Nursing Act, 1991, which means that in Ontario, only members of CNO can use the titles of nurse, Registered Nurse, Registered Practical Nurse, or any variation, abbreviation or equivalent in another language. Individuals who refer to themselves as nurses without being registered with CNO can be prosecuted under the Nursing Act, 1991 and RHPA.

sources.quote: Quebec requires a CNESST permit for personnel placement agencies
sources.publisher: Commission des normes, de l'équité, de la santé et de la sécurité du travail (CNESST)
sources.title: Mandatory licence for personnel placement agencies | CNESST
sources.evidence: Personnel placement agencies and temporary foreign worker recruitment agencies must hold a licence issued by the CNESST to conduct their activities in Quebec, and this licence is mandatory. Any application for a personnel placement agency licence must be accompanied by a bond of $15,000.

sources.quote: can be paid in advance during the year rather than at filing
sources.title: Apply for Advance Payments of the Tax Credit for Home-Support Services for Seniors | Revenu Québec
sources.evidence: If you want to benefit from your tax credit faster, you can claim it in advance by applying for advance payments. With advance payments, you will not have to wait until you file your income tax return to claim the tax credit. Advance payments are made only by direct deposit, and you have until December 1 of a given year to apply. To qualify, you or your spouse must have been 70 or over on December 31.

sources.quote: Under CASL an inquiry creates implied consent for six months only
sources.title: From Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: An inquiry or application by the recipient within the six month period immediately before the message was sent establishes an existing business relationship allowing implied consent, compared with the two-year period for a purchase or lease of goods or services.

sources.quote: personalized advertising policies bar remarketing and audiences built on health conditions
sources.title: Health in personalized advertising - Advertising Policies Help
sources.evidence: Health content includes physical or mental health conditions, including diseases, sexual health, and chronic health conditions. Google doesn't allow personalized advertising based on personal hardships, which include health conditions, treatments, procedures; advertisers can't use advertiser-curated audiences for health-related sensitive content.

sources.quote: Local Services Ads have no home care category in Canada
sources.title: Getting started with Local Services Ads - Canada - Local Services Help
sources.evidence: Local Services Ads in Canada are available only for certain service categories, including appliance repair services, carpet cleaning services, cleaning services, electricians, HVAC, junk removal services, lawn care services, locksmiths, movers, pest control services, plumbers, roofers, tree services, and water damage services.

flags.quote: Ontario has licensed temporary help agencies under the Employment Standards Act since January 2024
flags.issue: The licensing requirement took effect July 1, 2024, not January 2024. Ontario's Employment Standards Act guide states that beginning on July 1, 2024, temporary help agencies are required to hold a licence to operate and recruiters are required to hold a licence to act as a recruiter, with transitional rules for applications submitted before that date.
